summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the signing of definitive binding agreements for a joint venture to develop a ~770-room Hotel101 in Bangkok, Thailand. The project will be jointly developed with Origin Hotel (subsidiary of Origin Property PCL, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand). No price per share, premium, or changes to share structure are involved. This is a routine business development press release regarding a new hotel project, not a special situation corporate transaction.
